note: Coverage is limited to executives explicitly verifiable in sources.json. No individuals, titles, or contact details were fabricated. Each record separates FACT (fact + source_references) from AI HYPOTHESIS (ai_hypothesis) and RECOMMENDATION (indegene_angle, engagement_recommendation).

executives.name: Luke Miels
executives.fact: Luke Miels assumed the CEO role on 1 January 2026, succeeding Emma Walmsley. He attributed FY2025 growth mainly to Specialty Medicines, citing double-digit growth in Respiratory, Immunology & Inflammation, Oncology and HIV.
executives.ai_hypothesis: A CEO in his first full year typically re-examines commercial models, vendor rosters and cost structures; his stated Specialty and pipeline focus aligns with the concurrent Accelerate Growth strategy and the £1.9bn savings program.
executives.indegene_angle: The transition is the moment to position Company DAAI and Omnichannel as enablers of the Accelerate Growth strategy and as a cost-efficiency lever for the savings target, before preferred-vendor rosters are finalized.
executives.why_it_matters: A first-year CEO finalises preferred-vendor rosters now — timing outreach to his Specialty and savings agenda beats waiting for the FY2025-priority map to settle.
executives.engagement_recommendation: Map Miels's public priorities from the FY2025 and Q2 2026 statements and craft an executive briefing linking Company services to his Specialty and pipeline focus.

executives.name: Emma Walmsley
executives.fact: Emma Walmsley stepped down from the Board on 31 December 2025, with her employment ending 30 September 2026, handing the CEO role to Luke Miels.
executives.ai_hypothesis: As an outgoing CEO in a transition year, her influence over new vendor commitments is likely diminishing; decision authority is shifting to Miels and his incoming priorities.
executives.indegene_angle: Direct new-business engagement should be oriented toward the incoming leadership rather than the departing CEO; retain awareness of legacy relationships she shaped.
executives.why_it_matters: Her influence over new vendor commitments is already fading — anchoring outreach on her legacy risks being stranded once Miels sets the agenda.
executives.engagement_recommendation: Do not anchor outreach to Walmsley; use the transition as context when engaging Miels and the wider leadership team.

executives.name: Roy Jakobs
executives.fact: Roy Jakobs, CEO of Royal Philips, joined the GSK Board as a Non-Executive Director from 13 July 2026.
executives.ai_hypothesis: Adding a health-technology CEO to the board may reinforce GSK's digital and AI agenda and raise board-level expectations for technology partners.
executives.indegene_angle: A tech-oriented board voice strengthens the case for Company's DAAI and Tech Solutions offerings and raises the bar for demonstrated digital sophistication.
executives.why_it_matters: A Philips-CEO board voice raises expectations for digital sophistication — proposals without digital-maturity evidence will fall short.
executives.engagement_recommendation: Sharpen Company DAAI and Tech Solutions positioning to match a more tech-forward board agenda; reference digital-maturity outcomes in proposals.
